name: shared-bun-elysia
description: Shared Bun + Elysia 2.0 backend library for DesignForFeature services: request context (AsyncLocalStorage), multi-tenant PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM (tenant registry, pool per tenant, LISTEN/NOTIFY sync), multi-tenant Kafka logs (batched, masked, tenant key or topic per tenant), JWT, AppError + ResponseType replies, search helpers and AppHttp service calls.
author: DesignForFeature

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun x --bun tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun scripts/fix-declaration-imports.mjs
scripts.typecheck: bun x --bun tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun x --bun tsc -p example/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run check:style && bun run test && bun run build
